notes.title: Game update of March 22
notes.content:
1) Fixed a bug with the game hanging on the boss train.
2) Optimized the game code for better performance.

notes.title: News
notes.content:
Hey hello everyone! In this text, we want to say that everything is going according to plan! We have already begun to create the third level. Gradually we reduce the big difficulty of the game, and we will probably add a new function for choosing the difficulty. Now in the demo version of the game there are still some flaws that we will avoid in further development.


Hello! 
These are new updates for the demo version of the game! And the game itself in general.

What's new? ОК!

1) Now the boss "Eye" Shows where the bullets will fly in different directions.
2) The movements hero's satellite were accelerated.
3) Hero movement speed increased.
4) The hero's firing button and satellite control have been changed.
5) Now shooting is carried out automatically when the button is pressed.


25.03.2023
A new message. At release, the game will be translated into the following languages: Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish French, Ukrainian, German, Italian, Traditional Chinese.


15.08.2023
The game is ready, now there are final preparations for release.

I had a lot of fun making this game. It was funny and sometimes sad. Something didn't work. And what happened quickly and well.

I hope you enjoy the game very much. 

Well....... Add it to your wish list and see you on September 25th!
